content.text: The blockchain does not have a map of restricted countries. A wallet address in Lagos processes a transaction identically to one in London. USDT moves from a buyer in Manila to a seller in Harare in under 60 seconds — no correspondent bank, no SWIFT delay, no compliance officer deciding whether the corridor is permitted. This is the operational reality that creators across Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Ethiopia, Venezuela, Zimbabwe, Cameroon, Tanzania, and the Philippines are using right now to sell [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-honest-side-side|Digital Product]] products to a global audience. The infrastructure exists. GitHub Pages or [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-workers-crypto-payment-webhooks-explained-digital-creators-4|COREMERCH guide to cloudflare]] Pages serves the storefront. [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-nowpayments-integration-static-site-crypto-payments-complete|nowpayments]] verifies the payment on-chain and fires a webhook automatically. The product delivers before the buyer closes their wallet. The only question is whether you have assembled the stack correctly.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Selling Digital Products from Africa: The Complete Infrastructure Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-africa-step-step-deployment-guide. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Platforms have a nasty habit of blocking transactions from 'high-risk' countries like Tanzania. But what if you had a payment system that didn't rely on those platforms? With NOWPayments and Cloudflare infrastructure, you can create a sovereign digital commerce stack that processes transactions directly on-chain, bypassing platform restrictions and associated fees. This means you can sell to your customers without worrying about payment blockages or limitations.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you start deploying your sovereign digital commerce stack, you'll need to set up a few essential components. These include a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, a backend logic service like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, an order storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets, and a file delivery system like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. You'll also need to integrate NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, which incurs a 0.5% fee.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to configure your NOWPayments integration with your selected cryptocurrency networks. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON, which settle transactions in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10. You'll also need to set up your file delivery system to automatically send products to customers once payment is confirmed on-chain.
With NOWPayments, you can process transactions directly on-chain, bypassing platform restrictions and associated fees.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, it's time to go live and process your first transaction. Simply create a new product, configure your NOWPayments integration, and start selling. When a customer makes a purchase, NOWPayments will automatically verify the payment on-chain, and your file delivery system will send the product to the customer. With this infrastructure in place, you can start selling to your customers without worrying about payment blockages or limitations.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

The Edge Commerce Stack that COREMERCH deploys most frequently combines Cloudflare Pages for storefront hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend webhook handling and order processing, Supabase for order storage, Resend for transactional email delivery, and NOWPayments for crypto payment verification. The total monthly cost is zero. The scale ceiling is significantly higher than what most individual creators need — Cloudflare Workers handles 100,000 requests per day on the free tier, Supabase provides 500MB of PostgreSQL storage, and Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month. For a creator in any country on earth, this stack provides the same infrastructure as a well-funded e-commerce operation at no monthly cost.
Is crypto trading legal in Tanzania?

The most practical path for creators in restricted countries starts with NOWPayments configured to receive USDT on Tron as the primary payment coin. USDT is a stable coin pegged to the US dollar — your revenue does not fluctuate with crypto market movements. Tron network fees are under $0.10, and settlement takes under 60 seconds. Once USDT arrives in your wallet, you convert to local currency through P2P exchanges — Binance P2P is available in most countries and supports naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees. The conversion takes 20 to 30 minutes on average and costs 2 to 5 percent.
By using Cloudflare infrastructure and NOWPayments, you can create a sovereign digital commerce stack that is scalable and secure.

You can also shop for more products on our website at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack with NOWPayments and Cloudflare infrastructure, follow these concrete steps: set up a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, configure a backend logic service like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, integrate NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, and set up a file delivery system like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Complete the deployment by configuring your payment and delivery pipeline, going live, and processing your first transaction.
Frequently Asked Questions
Is NOWPayments available in Tanzania?
Yes, NOWPayments supports transactions in the Tanzanian shilling and integrates with multiple cryptocurrency networks, including BSC, Solana, and TRON.
What is the fee for using NOWPayments?
NOWPayments incurs a 0.5% fee for each transaction, which is significantly lower than traditional payment processing fees.
Can I use NOWPayments with my existing e-commerce platform?
Yes, you can integrate NOWPayments with your existing e-commerce platform, but you'll need to follow our instructions for setting up a sovereign digital commerce stack.
How do I configure my NOWPayments integration with multiple cryptocurrency networks?

To configure your NOWPayments integration with multiple cryptocurrency networks, follow our instructions for setting up a payment and delivery pipeline, which includes configuring your NOWPayments integration with BSC, Solana, and TRON.
Can I scale my infrastructure to meet increasing demand?
Yes, with Cloudflare infrastructure and NOWPayments, you can easily scale your payment and delivery pipeline by adding more instances, configuring load balancing, and optimizing your deployment.
